facts.text: Tim mentions having reminders that help him escape reality, and he plans to visit more Harry Potter-related locations in the future.

evidence.quote: Thanks! I have lots of reminders of it - kind of a way to escape reality.
Definitely, those reminders really help. And there's definitely a chance I'll be visiting more HP spots in the future.

facts.text: Tim expresses that visiting Harry Potter locations allows him to feel like he is stepping into the books.

evidence.quote: It feels like I'm stepping into the books!

facts.text: John acknowledges Tim's enthusiasm for the Harry Potter world and encourages him to continue engaging with it.

evidence.quote: So cool that you get to immerse yourself in that world. So glad you found something that brings you so much joy. Keep diving in and enjoying it!

facts.text: John shares a photo from a recent basketball game, which he was participating in.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic from a recent game. [image: a photo of a basketball game being played in a gym]
That was from a game I just played. I was in it! It was awesome being out there, doing what I love.
